question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
with_day_number AS (
    SELECT 
        sale_date,
        daily_sales,
        CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(sale_date) OVER (), sale_date) AS DOUBLE) AS day_num
    FROM daily_sales
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
    FROM with_day_number
),
predicted_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-03' AS target_date UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-04' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-05' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-06' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-07' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-08' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-09' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-10'
),
predicted_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.target_date,
        r.slope * CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', (SELECT MIN(sale_date) FROM daily_sales), pd.target_date) AS DOUBLE) + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM predicted_dates pd
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
ma5 AS (
    SELECT 
        p.target_date,
        p.predicted_sales,
        (SELECT AVG(p2.predicted_sales) 
         FROM predicted_sales p2 
         WHERE p2.target_date BETWEEN p.target_date - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND p.target_date + INTERVAL '2' DAY
        ) AS moving_avg_5
    FROM predicted_sales p
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5) AS sum_of_4_moving_averages
FROM ma5
WHERE target_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-12-05' AND DATE '2018-12-08'
